description: AI-first video production front door with 33 internal skills, 37 core specialist plugins, illustrated-history and cinematic-documentary routes, and opt-in H2 Squire.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nolane Video Command Center as the front door. Restore repo/project state, route by visual genre, search the existing resource pool before generating media, prefer rights-cleared recorded Foley/ambience/music over synthesized sound, and require full moving-picture and soundtrack review. For illustrated/cartoon history, use the illustrated-history animation director with expressive rigs, varied settings, pose/action/prop choreography, multi-plane motion, animated maps and infographics. For footage-led historical documentaries, choose footage, 2.5D, Blender, Remotion, maps and motion per shot. Use H2 Squire only when the user explicitly wants its separate vector style. Preserve the parallel asset-library boundary.
interface.longDescription: Private video-production orchestrator with 33 internal skills, 37 core specialist plugins and three distinct historical routes: illustrated/cartoon history, footage-led cinematic documentary and opt-in H2 Squire vector military history. Includes recorded-sound-first direction, a searchable rights-aware audio preview bank, camera/motion planning, source-backed reference studies, stem-based sound design and evidence-gated full audiovisual QA and a reusable illustrated-history motion system. Specialist plugins require explicit host activation; no hidden plugin-to-plugin invocation is claimed. Protects the parallel asset-library workstream.

name: nolane-video-command-center
